name: @coda/coding-agent
description: Terminal Coding Agent application for Coda

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/mark-bin-executable.mjs dist/bin.js
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && biome check src test scripts vitest*.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
